units: metres; a along the cross-wall's face from O = world (752, 440) toward the corridor's back wall, t into the wall (beyond side), h up. Screen: common.project / portal2.scr (clamp-world px).

sign.font: Roboto (game's bundled Roboto-Variable.ttf, SIL OFL 1.1, Roboto-OFL.txt), wght 700, wdth 75, stencil bridges cut by script (design/tools/text_layer.py bridges())

leaf.pocket: a from 1.463 to 5.463 m along the wall (into the mass behind the corridor's back wall)

light_table.note: vertex colour (grey) per (a column, h row) on the leaf's front plane: the place's light (corridor luminaire, door light, floor bounce, each seen only through the doorway) over the brightest place, in sRGB as Godot modulates

wall.name: bf_jamb_plate
wall.dims: blast frame jamb plates: 25 mm steel, 0.55 m wide, 0 to 3.92 m, three plates
wall.job: armour round the opening's far jamb; part of the embedded steel subframe that carries the blast load into the wall

wall.name: bf_head_plate
wall.dims: blast frame head plates: 25 mm steel, 0.87 m tall (3.05 to 3.92 m), three plates
wall.job: armour over the opening (shows above the hood from 3.5 m)

wall.name: bf_bolts
wall.dims: M24 anchor bolts at 300 mm pitch
wall.job: hold the armour plates to the embedded subframe

wall.name: sign_plate
wall.dims: steel sign plate 3.0 x 0.54 m, 3 mm, lusterless white (37875, weathered)
wall.job: carries the RESTRICTED AREA stencil at the security boundary

wall.name: sign_bolts
wall.job: hold the sign plate to the concrete

wall.name: slot_seal_front
wall.job: seals the leaf's front face at the pocket's mouth

wall.name: slot_seal_back
wall.job: seals the leaf's back face at the pocket's mouth

wall.name: leaf_edge_parked
wall.dims: the blast leaf's leading edge, 0.24 m, parked flush in the pocket's mouth
wall.job: the inner blast door, slid open into the wall

wall.name: rail_recess
wall.dims: rail recess 80 mm in the steel threshold

wall.name: rail_head
wall.dims: crane-rail head 30 mm, flush, polished by the wheels
wall.job: the blast leaf's wheels run on it

front.name: bf_near_head
front.dims: blast frame head plate over the near jamb, 0.16 m
front.job: the head plate carried over the column's approach face

front.name: lamp_conduit_strap2
front.dims: one-hole saddle strap 24 mm at 3.45 m, anchored to the concrete
front.job: holds the 1.54 m vertical lamp conduit (within 0.9 m of the elbow and of the lamp box's strap point)

leaf.name: leaf_face
leaf.dims: 10 mm steel faceplate (36081) over a concrete core, 3.95 x 3.2 m

leaf.name: leaf_nose
leaf.job: stiffens the leading edge that seats in the receiver

leaf.name: leaf_seam0..1
leaf.dims: faceplate weld seams at 1.3 and 2.6 m

leaf.name: leaf_bottom_rail
leaf.job: carries the leaf's weight onto the wheel trucks

leaf.name: leaf_truck0..1
leaf.job: cover the two flanged-wheel trucks on the floor rail

leaf.name: leaf_sweep
leaf.job: seals the leaf's foot to the threshold

leaf.name: edge_stripes
leaf.job: caught-between marking on the leading edge (OSHA yellow)
